open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory
open scoped ENNReal
definition_context: Kernel α α is a measurable transition kernel with nonnegative extended measure values.
Kernel.IsReversible κ μ means equality of the two nonnegative set integrals for every pair of measurable sets: ∫⁻ x in A, κ x B ∂μ = ∫⁻ x in B, κ x A ∂μ.
cases.statement:
example {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α]
    [Countable α] [MeasurableSingletonClass α] (κ : Kernel α α) (μ : Measure α)
    (h : ∀ x y, μ {x} * κ x {y} = μ {y} * κ y {x}) :
    Kernel.IsReversible κ μ

cases.context:
open Set
open scoped RealInnerProductSpace
variable {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
definition_context: IsMinOn f Set.univ z means f z ≤ f x for every x.
gradient f x is the real Hilbert-space vector representing fderiv ℝ f x; fderiv and hence this vector are zero when the function is not differentiable at x.
T^[N] x₀ denotes N-fold function iteration, including the identity at N=0.
cases.statement:
example {f : E → ℝ} {α β h : ℝ} {z : E}
    (hz : IsMinOn f univ z) (hh : 0 ≤ h) (hstep : β * h ≤ 1)
    (hu : ∀ x y, f y ≤ f x + inner ℝ (gradient f x) (y - x) + β / 2 * ‖y - x‖ ^ 2)
    (hpl : ∀ x, 2 * α * (f x - f z) ≤ ‖gradient f x‖ ^ 2)
    (x₀ : E) (N : ℕ) :
    f ((fun x => x - h • gradient f x)^[N] x₀) - f z ≤
      (1 - α * h) ^ N * (f x₀ - f z)

definition_context: StrongConvexOn Set.univ k V uses the convention V(a • x + b • y) ≤ a*V(x)+b*V(y)−(k/2)*a*b*‖x−y‖² for a,b≥0 and a+b=1.
IsMinOn V Set.univ x₀ means V x₀ ≤ V x for every x.
cases.statement:
example
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    {V : E → ℝ} {k : ℝ} (hV : StrongConvexOn (Set.univ : Set E) k V)
    (x₀ : E) (hx₀ : IsMinOn V (Set.univ : Set E) x₀) :
    ∀ x : E, V x₀ + (k / 4) * ‖x - x₀‖ ^ 2 ≤ V x
